parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The username of the authorized user of the cloud computer. You must specify an existing authorized user of the cloud computer to generate the credential
parameters.help_zh: 云电脑授权用户的用户名。必须传入云电脑现有的授权用户才能成功生成凭证
parameters.name: end_user_id

parameters.help_en: The password of the authorized user of the cloud computer
parameters.help_zh: 云电脑授权用户的密码
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud computer connection task
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud computer for which to generate a connection credential. This parameter is required to generate the credential
parameters.help_zh: 需生成连接凭证的云电脑ID。必须传入该字段才能成功生成凭证
parameters.name: desktop_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the client. If you use the Wuying client, you can view this parameter in the About dialog box on the client logon page
parameters.help_zh: 客户端唯一标识。若使用无影客户端，可在客户端登录界面的关于对话框中查看该参数
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.help_en:
Specifies a custom user-mode application that is automatically started after the credential is obtained.

appPath: a value of the String type that specifies the application startup file path, such as `"C:\Program Files (x86)\000\000.exe"`. Use double backslashes (\) as path separators.
appParameter: a value of the String type that specifies the application startup parameters, such as `"meetingid 000 meetingname aaa"`. Separate parameters with spaces
parameters.help_zh:
当前参数可以配置自定义用户态应用，当成功获取凭证后，自动执行应用。

appPath：String类型，应用启动文件路径，例如：`"C:\\Program Files (x86)\\000\\000.exe"`，注意路径分隔符要用双斜杠（\\）。
appParameter：String类型，应用启动参数，例如：`"meetingid 000 meetingname aaa"`，注意参数与参数之间直接用空格
parameters.name: command_content

TaskCode.description_en:
The ticket used to connect to the user instance. Before you use the ticket, Base64-decode its content and save it as an xxx.ica file, and then open the file. The following Python code provides an example:

```
import base64
response = {
    "Ticket": "W0VuY29kaW5nXQ0KSW5wdXRFbmNvZGluZz1V********",
    "RequestId": "1CBAFFAB-B697-4049-A9B1-67E1FC5F****",
}
f = open ('xxx.ica', 'w')
out = base64.b64decode(response['Ticket'])
f.write(out)
f.close()
```
